upheld.title: Sort option labels and selection logic duplicated in Catalog.razor
upheld.detail: The PR adds a SortOptions dictionary (value to label) in @code and uses it for the trigger label, but the listbox still hard-codes the four <li> options with the same labels and four copy-pasted aria-selected ternaries. Adding or renaming an option now needs edits in two places in the same file.
upheld.requirement: PR check guideline 'No ... duplicated logic'; the same component already renders lists by iterating data (e.g. the page tokens from GetPageTokens)

upheld.title: Primary repro video never shows the pager or page 1's last price
upheld.detail: In video 01 (TC-BUG-40-01), the frames after Next show $64.99/$64.99/$69.99 with no pager or page indicator visible, and no frame shows page 1's last card. The page-1→page-2 price boundary from the bug's Step 3 can only be proved by combining video 07 (page 1 ends $59.99) with video 01.
upheld.requirement: Step 3: Note the prices on page 1, then click Next ... no product on a later page costs less than a product on an earlier page

dismissed.title: Restoring a stored sort on first load renders and fetches the catalog twice
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The stored sort is restored correctly (TC-BUG-40-09), and the brief default order before the restore existed before this change, when catalog-sort.js reordered the cards in place after load. The outcome is right, so this is no correctness defect or regression.
